Location Omaha, NE Requisition Number: 2026 - 029 Department Anesthesiology 50000508 Business Unit(College/Institute) College of Medicine FTE: 100 Reg-Temp Full-Time Regular Work Schedule As determined by Department Chairman Requisition Category Faculty Requisition Title Anesthesiology Faculty/Rank DOQ Job Title/Academic Rank Anesthesiology Faculty/Rank DOQ Additional Requisition Title Appointment Type DOQ - DEPENDS ON QUALS Salary Range Salary Commensurate with Experience Job/EEO Category Faculty Job Requisition Begin Date 01/15/2026 Position Qualification Position Summary Anesthesiologists to Join University of Nebraska Medical Center FacultyThe Department of Anesthesiology at the University of Nebraska Medical Center in Omaha is recruiting for opportunities in general anesthesia, critical care anesthesia and pediatric anesthesia. Our renowned department consists of 80 clinical faculty, 60 CRNAs and 65 residents and fellows. We have a strong history of outstanding patient care, innovation, and excellent educational program.
